question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

My teacher __said me__ that I would be famous one day
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e. '****told me'. **

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **the reporting verb '****told me' **should be used **instead of 'said me'. **
 
• The given sentence is an example of **an Assertive sentence in Indirect Speech.**
 
• When in** direct speech reporting verb is 'said to' it always changes into 'told' in indirect speech.**
 
• **Example**:
 
 
• **​Direct speech:** He **said to **me, "I am a teacher."
 
• **Indirect speech:** He **told** me that he was a teacher.
 
 
 
• ​So the **correct answer is option 2.**

** **__

__**Correct Sentence:**__ *My teacher **told me**** **that I would be famous one day.*
